summary_md: **Stable Diffusion Tutorials ([@SD_Tutorial](https://x.com/SD_Tutorial/status/2115719440235126870))** points to **Open-H3-Regenerate-2K**, an open replacement for MiniMax's closed H3 2K regenerate API: a three-step refinement that upscales a 768p H3 draft (121 frames) to 2560×1440, with [weights on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K) and [ComfyUI nodes](https://github.com/rdh9616/ComfyUI-Open-H3-Regenerate).
